[SWS_PER_00557]
d
If the
file
was opened with
ara::per::OpenMode
set to
kAppend
,
Persistency
shall always set the current position to the end of the
file
before writing data to the
file
according to [SWS_PER_00529], [SWS_PER_00530],
or [SWS_PER_00531].

(RS_PER_00004)
